faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Browse by topic to find what you need.

account.q1: How do I create an account on JeevanSaathiHub?
account.a1: Click the 'Register' button on the top right. Fill in your basic details, verify your mobile number via OTP, and complete your profile with photos and preferences. The entire process takes about 5–10 minutes.
account.q2: Can I edit my profile after registration?
account.a2: Yes! Go to My Profile → Edit Profile at any time. You can update photos, personal details, partner preferences, and lifestyle information whenever you like.
account.q3: How do I upload or change my profile photo?
account.a3: Navigate to My Profile → Photos. Click 'Add Photos' to upload from your device. You can upload up to 10 photos. Your primary photo is what other members see in search results.
account.q4: What should I do if I forget my password?
account.a4: Click 'Login' then 'Forgot Password'. Enter your registered email or mobile number and we'll send you a reset link or OTP within a few seconds.
account.q5: How do I delete my account?
account.a5: Go to Settings → Privacy → Delete Account. Please note this action is permanent and removes all your data. We recommend hiding your profile first if you only need a temporary break.

search.q1: How does the profile matching work?
search.a1: Our algorithm considers your partner preferences (age, religion, caste, education, location, lifestyle) and scores profiles by compatibility. The more complete your profile, the better your matches.
search.q2: Can I search profiles without registering?
search.a2: You can browse limited profile previews without registration. To view full profiles, contact details, or send interests you need a registered (free or premium) account.
search.q3: How do I filter search results?
search.a3: Use the Advanced Search panel to filter by age range, height, religion, mother tongue, education, profession, income, location, and more. Filters can be saved for quick future searches.
search.a4: Every day we curate a fresh set of highly compatible profiles just for you, based on your preferences and activity. Check your dashboard each morning for new suggestions.

connect.q1: How do I send an Interest to someone?
connect.a1: Open the profile you like and click 'Send Interest'. The member will be notified and can Accept or Decline. If they accept, you can start a conversation.
connect.a2: Once an interest is mutually accepted, both members can exchange messages through our secure in-app chat. Phone numbers and emails are only shared when both sides choose to share them.
connect.q3: Can I see who viewed my profile?
connect.a3: Yes. Go to My Activity → Profile Visitors to see members who recently viewed your profile. Premium members can see the full visitor list; free members see a limited count.
connect.a4: Shortlisting saves a profile to your private list so you can revisit it later. The other member is not notified when you shortlist them.

membership.q1: What is included in the free membership?
membership.a1: Free members can register, build a profile, view limited profile details, send up to 5 interests per day, and receive interests from others.
membership.q2: What extra features do premium plans offer?
membership.a2: Premium members get unlimited messaging, full contact detail access, advanced filters, highlighted profiles in search results, profile boost credits, and priority customer support.
membership.a3: We accept UPI, Net Banking, Credit/Debit Cards (Visa, Mastercard, RuPay), and popular wallets like Paytm and PhonePe. All transactions are secured by 256-bit SSL encryption.
membership.q4: Can I get a refund if I'm not satisfied?
membership.a4: We offer a 7-day refund policy for new premium subscriptions if you have not used any premium features. Contact support within 7 days of purchase with your order ID.
membership.q5: How do I cancel my subscription auto-renewal?
membership.a5: Go to Settings → Subscription → Manage Plan → Cancel Auto-Renewal. Your premium access continues until the current billing period ends.

safety.a1: Absolutely. We never sell your data to third parties. Your contact details are hidden by default and only revealed when you choose to share them. We are fully DPDP Act compliant.
safety.q2: How do I block or report a member?
safety.a2: Open the member's profile, tap the three-dot menu (⋮) and choose 'Block' or 'Report'. Blocked members cannot view your profile or message you. Our safety team reviews all reports within 24 hours.
safety.q3: How can I hide my profile temporarily?
safety.a3: Go to Settings → Privacy → Profile Visibility and toggle 'Hide Profile'. Your profile won't appear in searches, but existing conversations remain active.
safety.a4: We offer ID verification, mobile verification, and photo verification badges. Look for the blue ✓ Verified badge on profiles. Verification significantly increases trust and match quality.
